name: DeepScribe
description: DeepScribe is an enterprise-focused AI medical scribe that does not publish pricing or offer self-service signup. The platform targets mid-size practices and health systems at $350-500+/provider/month with mandatory annual contracts and $500-1,000 setup fees. A 5-provider clinic should expect $21,000-30,000+/year. DeepScribe offers ICD-10 coding suggestions and extensive template customization, but requires going through enterprise sales before learning cost or accessing the platform. Not designed for solo practitioners, small practices, or mental health-specific documentation. Therapists and psychiatrists should use purpose-built tools at 1/10th the cost.
short_description: Enterprise AI scribe at $350-500+/mo. No public pricing. ICD-10 coding. Built for mid-size practices, not solo clinicians or mental health.
one_liner: Enterprise ambient scribe at $350-500+/mo. No self-service. Not for solo practices.

tiers.name: EHR-Integrated

tiers.name: Enterprise

pricing.notes: NO public pricing page. NO free trial. NO self-service signup. Mandatory annual contracts. Must go through enterprise sales. For a 5-provider clinic: ~$21,000-30,000+/year before implementation. Not built for solo practitioners.

ambient_ai.description: Captures patient conversations and generates structured clinical notes with personalization over time.

best_for: Mid-size specialty practices (5-50 providers) with budget for $350-500+/provider/month
Practices on athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, or ModMed wanting native integration
Organizations that need highly customizable note templates per clinician
Orthopedics, cardiology, dermatology practices with complex documentation needs
not_for: Solo practitioners—no self-serve, pricing prohibitive, enterprise sales required
Small practices under 5 providers—$21,000+/year minimum is rarely justified
Mental health practices—Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo) cost 90% less
Psychiatrists—Freed ($39-119/mo) handles medication management at 1/5th the cost
Practices needing native Epic integration—DeepScribe uses browser extension only
Budget-conscious practices—Sunoh ($149/mo) or Freed offer similar features cheaper

seo.title: DeepScribe: Enterprise AI Scribe 2026 | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: DeepScribe: enterprise AI scribe at $350-500+/provider/mo. No public pricing. ICD-10 coding. Built for mid-size practices, not solo clinicians or mental health.

faqs.q: How much does DeepScribe cost in 2026?
faqs.a: DeepScribe does not publish pricing. Estimates from third-party sources: $350/provider/month without EHR integration, $450-500+/month with EHR integration. Mandatory annual contracts with $500-1,000 setup fees. A 5-provider clinic: ~$21,000-30,000+/year.

faqs.q: Does DeepScribe have a free trial?
faqs.a: No. DeepScribe has no public pricing, no free trial, and no self-service signup. You must go through enterprise sales before learning the cost or accessing the platform.

faqs.q: Is DeepScribe good for solo practitioners?
faqs.a: No. DeepScribe was built for enterprise health systems with dedicated IT departments. Solo practitioners should use Freed ($39-119/mo), Sunoh ($149/mo), or Heidi (free tier + $150/mo) instead—all offer self-service signup and transparent pricing.

faqs.q: Is DeepScribe good for mental health?
faqs.a: No. DeepScribe focuses on medical specialties (orthopedics, cardiology, dermatology) and does not offer mental health-specific templates. Therapists should use Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo). Psychiatrists should consider Freed ($39-119/mo).

faqs.q: DeepScribe vs Freed: which is better?
faqs.a: For solo and small practices: Freed. Freed costs $39-119/month with transparent pricing and self-service signup. DeepScribe costs $350-500+/month with mandatory sales calls and annual contracts. DeepScribe's main advantage is ICD-10 coding and extensive customization for specialty practices.
